senses.gloss: divorce by means of a deed (סֵפֶר כְּרִיתוּת).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 10b:14">Gitt. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>והא לאו בני כ׳ נינהו</he> but they (the gentiles) are not subject to the Jewish mode of divorce (how, then, can they act as judges in divorce cases)?
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:10">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:11">11</cite> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="B01282"><he>בְּרִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:15">Macc. III, 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01282"><he>כָּרֵת</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="K01182"><he>כְּרִיתוֹת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K01282"><he>כָּרֵת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite> (ref. to <he>כרתי</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 15:18">II Sam. XV, 18</cite>) <he>כורתי כ׳</he> (ed. Bub. <he>בריתות</he>) those who pass (final) decisions.
